y.label: CPU Usage
y.formula:
pick_max(
  pick_max(
    counter_rate(
      defaults(
        divide(
          max(system.process.cpu.total.time.ms),
          ifelse(
            count(kql='system.cpu.cores : *') > 0,
            max(system.cpu.cores),
            1
          )
        )
        ,0)
      )/counter_rate(max(@timestamp)),
    0
  ),
  defaults(max(system.process.cpu.total.pct),0)
)
